en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated this to us from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Nasr b. Mazahim from Lut b. Yahya from al-Harith b. Ka`b from Fatima bt.
`Ali (s). Yazid (la) called for the women of al-Husayn (as) to be jailed with `Ali b. al-Husayn (as) in a jail that had no protection from heat or cold, until their faces peeled.

A stone from the face of the Earth was not raised in the Bayt al-Maqdis except that fresh blood was found beneath it. The people saw red sunlight on the walls, as though it were sheets dyed in yellow;
until `Ali b. al-Husayn (as) was released with the women and the head of al-Husayn (as) was returned to Karbala’.
